sentences.text:
( Shri Pranay Joshi - Panel Lawyer For State)
 This application coming on for admission this day,

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 433/2021 registered at Police Station Oon District Khargone (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 344, 506, 376(3), 376(2)(N)
of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 3,4,5(L) and 5(J)(ii)/6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for applicant seeks permission to withdraw the M.Cr.C.
He sought a direction to the trial court to conclude the trial expeditiously.
